status: OPEN: independent tracking only; existing action analysis untouched
reviewed_scope: E65-E68 current source-annotation work plus missing historical backfill

rules.completeness: No claim that an episode or pair is exhaustive until every source line and each multi-action line passes editorial audit.
rules.relationship_vs_action: Physical event is not proof of relationship status or future intent.
rules.future: Keep all hypothetical scenes separate from verified canon. Narrative/setup predictions should remain non-graphic.

gaps.name: Atomic semantic completion
gaps.why: Large scene ranges and generic checkpoints hide multiple actions and reactions
gaps.missing: Every meaningful individual actor-to-recipient act and its source span
gaps.closure: Full line dispositions, multi-event splitting and reviewer QA

gaps.name: Verbatim evidence positions
gaps.why: Global line references alone cannot distinguish several statements and actions inside a line
gaps.missing: Exact phrase offsets plus original wording check
gaps.closure: Store source line number, exact character offsets, quote checksum and validated actor ownership

gaps.name: Relationship status history
gaps.why: Closeness and contact do not prove current emotional commitments or mutual future goals
gaps.missing: Relationship labels, certainty, change point, explicit dialogue, contradictions
gaps.closure: State as-of-each-scene, and distinguish user-supplied canon from narrator evidence

gaps.name: Knowledge and POV
gaps.why: Some scenes include imagined events, private interpretations and later reports
gaps.missing: Speaker/narrator, thinker, observer, first-hand vs inferred knowledge
gaps.closure: Per-action perspective and knowledge transitions with evidence

gaps.name: Stop and boundary transitions
gaps.why: Suggested or attempted event must never appear as completed action
gaps.missing: Initiation, verbal response, stop, immediate compliance, final outcome
gaps.closure: Separate source-anchored records linked in causal order

gaps.name: Clothing and visual context
gaps.why: Garment state, visual possibility and actual observation get merged
gaps.missing: Per-character garment before/after, line of sight, gaze actor, seen vs assumed
gaps.closure: Scene snapshots and individual gaze records

gaps.name: Encounter identity and story time
gaps.why: Chapter boundaries and flashback cuts can double-count one continuous encounter
gaps.missing: Unique encounter IDs across chapters, chronological reordering and time gaps
gaps.closure: Narration time, in-world time, scene continuity links, unknown time marker

gaps.name: Pair vs group roles
gaps.why: Being present in a shared room is not identical to participating in an action
gaps.closure: Only sourced per-participant edges, shared encounter id where actual

gaps.name: Author pacing and scene mechanism
gaps.why: Contact-category scores do not show how everyday scenes set up the author's chapter pacing
gaps.missing: Ordinary activity, opportunity, interruption, dialogue, reaction, aftermath and number of scenes between
gaps.closure: Beat segmentation and measured distances in scenes/lines/episodes

gaps.name: Milestone first occurrence and repetition
gaps.why: Highest in latest unit may not be new across whole story
gaps.missing: First verified, previous peak, repeat, skipped episode, current pair state
gaps.closure: Chronological full-history index with scope-limited no-hit reporting

gaps.name: Prediction candidates and validation
gaps.why: Potential future event cannot be presented as an inevitable escalation
gaps.missing: Grounded non-graphic candidate scene title, everyday setup, barriers, alternative paths and uncertainty
gaps.closure: Separate frozen hypotheses and later source outcome comparison

gaps.name: Second-pass editorial QA
gaps.why: 237 labels on 191 lines guarantee per-line coverage, not exhaustive semantic multi-action capture
gaps.missing: Independent review of segmentation and within-line action ownership
gaps.closure: Two-pass review sign-off with reviewed offsets and adjudicated ambiguities

gaps.name: Conflicting age evidence
gaps.why: Original E64 L12766 gives age 18 in Dhika's inner dialogue; user separately states Bantu is 20
gaps.missing: Resolve whether source describes in-world age at scene-time, character misstatement, or editorial inconsistency
gaps.closure: Preserve both sources and classify provenance. Do not silently replace source or infer timeline change.

gaps.name: Bridge identity and knowledge timing
gaps.why: E64 phone video is explained in E65; earlier E64 shower interaction is later recounted across a flashback
gaps.missing: Timestamp of recorded media vs message posting, observer knowledge, and scene identities across retrospective handoff
gaps.closure: Merge shared-event IDs without double-counting; assign evidence at the first source line that establishes the fact

last_editorial_note: No category in this register claims full completion. Add evidence, never weaken old detailed records to summaries.
